title: Full integer state value function on the Perfection-tuned base bot
question: Does the result of experiments 13 and 16 hold when the learner and the opponents are the Perfection-tuned bots of experiment 17: how well does a value function over the exact integer state predict the remaining score, and does the learned model or Monte Carlo predict better?
change: Experiment 16 unchanged except the bots: learner greedy-full-probe-perf, opponents greedy-full-probe-perf, greedy-full-combo-perf and the anchor greedy-full-probe-perf (rl-gate defaults on dev da04376).
method: Training-set sizes 1k to 300k games (seeds 1..), 10,000 held-out games (seeds 500,000,000..), RMSE of the predicted remaining score
setups: Perfection, 16×16 continents, 4 players, Crazy, seat 0 Xin-Xi (human seat), learner greedy-full-probe-perf; opponents greedy-full-probe-perf, greedy-full-combo-perf, greedy-full-probe-perf (anchor), seats shuffled per seed (rl-gate defaults)
